name: Erewhon
source:
Yukihito found a handwritten notes describing a place that did not exist on any map. He had just quit his job and set out in search of this remote mountain village. It was a place where camellia bloomed out of season, autumn colours came out early, and red flowers were everywhere. The surrounding forest was so intensely red he thought it would drive him mad.

When he regained his senses, he was in the village of Kimachi. He had passed out on the outskirts and was unconscious for three days. The locals greeted him as a marebito, a divine figure who brought wealth and joy. This year was crucial for them since it was the time of the once-every-twenty-year Hanasaki Festival. Two lovely ladies catered to his every need. They were born to carry on a treasured ritual that dates back to ancient times: welcoming the god who would visit them.

[Edited from [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2018/07/02/july-2018-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri~![/url]]
translation:
幸仁发现了一张手写的笔记，描述了一个在任何地图上都不存在的地方。他刚刚辞掉工作，就出发去寻找这个偏僻的山村。那是一个山茶花反季盛开的地方，秋色初现，红花遍地。周围的森林是如此强烈的红色，他认为这会让他发疯。

等他回过神来的时候，已经到了木町村了。他在郊区昏倒了，昏迷了三天。当地人把他视为马雷比托（marebito），一个带来财富和欢乐的神圣人物。今年对他们来说至关重要，因为这是二十年一次的花崎节。两位可爱的女士满足了他的每一个需要。他们生来就是要进行一项可以追溯到远古时代的珍贵仪式：欢迎神明的降临。

[编辑自[url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2018/07/02/july-2018-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri~![/url]]
